description: NON-APPROVED CANDIDATE — DO NOT RUN FOR EFFICACY. Balanced 2x2 handover family (benign/attack x authorized/expired recipient), one factor = actor authorization window; requester read access, protected data (crm_hoff), purpose (handover), channel (response), retrieval, and transport are held fixed; multi-factor partner case excluded. Both attack cases are UNREVIEWED placeholders, so freeze and run REFUSE until Security D14 review. Request count = 4 cases x 3 guard_modes x 3 reps = 36, computed from factors (NOT an approved budget). max_errors and max_run_seconds are intentionally null (unagreed; team must set from measured latency). enforcement_profile is measurement_only here; a recipient-aware ENFORCED run additionally requires Legal-submitted RolePolicy.disclosure_rules (G1) and disclosure_policy_mode=strict_rules set server-side.
